# Kamchatka


## English

[edit]

### Etymology

[edit]

From Russian Камча́тка (Kamčátka), derived from Koryak [script needed] (konchachal), perhaps meaning “men of the far end”.

### Pronunciation

[edit]

  * enPR: kăm-chät′kə^{[1]}
  * enPR: kăm-chăt′kə^{[2]}

### Proper noun

[edit]

Three Brothers rocks

Kamchatka

  1.   2. A long peninsula forming part of Kamchatka Krai in the Far East of Russia, lying between the Pacific Ocean and the Sea of Okhotsk. synonym ▲

    Synonym: Kamchatka Peninsula
  3.   4. A krai and federal subject of Russia, in the Russian Far East.
  5.   6. (with the) A river in Kamchatka Krai, Russia.

#### Derived terms

[edit]

  * Kamchatkan
  * Kamchatka Peninsula
  * kamchatkite

# Definition of 'Kamchatka'

## Kamchatka in British English

(kæmˈtʃætkə , Russian kamˈtʃatkə )

noun

a peninsula in E Russia, between the Sea of Okhotsk and the Bering Sea. Length: about 1200 km (750 miles)

Collins English Dictionary. Copyright © HarperCollins Publishers

## Kamchatka in American English

(kɑmˈtʃɑtkə )

peninsula in NE Siberia, between the Sea of Okhotsk & the Bering Sea: c. 750 mi (1,207 km) long; 140,000 sq mi (362,599 sq km)
